summary: iter357 Caja/POS testing: backend pytest (17/17 passing) and frontend Playwright E2E on the Caja tab both PASS. Logo raster in ticket, drawer OFF by default, user-text sanitization (anti-injection), SUNMI JS USDK transport failing-closed with explicit error message, and Navegador path all verified. No defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: receipt_printing.py _ascii() strips all control bytes (0x20-0x7e only) — correctly prevents ESC/GS injection from user text (H4 verified).
receiptPrinter.js uses sunmi-js-sdk with sendEscCommand([hex]); resolves only on ACK, rejects on timeout/socket closed (H1+H2 verified).
Old print-ws-url input removed; replaced with print-jsusdk-note.
test_credentials: Bearer smoke_caja_logo_iter357 for API; session_token cookie 'smoke_caja_logo_iter357' for UI (both resolve to admin via conftest/seed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Caja tab testids verified: inventory-tab-print, print-transport-{simulacion|sunmi|navegador}, print-logo-toggle (default ON), print-drawer-toggle (default OFF), print-sample-btn, print-preview-paper, print-preview-logo, print-preview-drawer, print-jsusdk-note, print-result-error, print-result-ok. SUNMI preview requires ~5-6s wait before error surfaces (waitForConnection=4s + overhead); use >=6s wait when asserting fail-closed behavior.
verified_scenarios: GET /api/admin/pos/receipt/sample?width=48 → open_drawer=false, has_logo=true, ESC/POS starts with 1b40, contains GS v 0, no drawer kick.
GET /api/admin/pos/receipt/sample?width=48&open_drawer=true&print_logo=false → drawer kick present, GS v 0 absent.
POST /api/admin/pos/receipt/build with malicious ESC p bytes in business_name/footer/item fields → exactly one FULL_CUT, no DRAWER_KICK injected.
UI Simulación + logo ON (default) + drawer OFF (default): preview shows '[ LOGO ]' marker, logo note visible, drawer note hidden.
UI logo toggle OFF: '[ LOGO ]' marker and note disappear.
UI drawer toggle ON: preview-drawer note appears.

UI SUNMI transport: jsusdk-note visible, print-ws-url absent, Ticket de prueba fails with print-result-error 'Sin conexión con el servicio de impresión SUNMI...' + matching toast; NO print-result-ok shown (fail-closed confirmed).
UI Navegador transport: opens system print path without errors.
